title: 'UAP hedge' tweet responding to FT Alphaville article on financial risks of UAP disclosure

tellings.quote: like I think I have a I had like a semi- tongue-in-cheek tweet like four or five years ago that's like, "What's your UAP hedge hashtag Bitcoin?" It was a response to this uh, like FT alpha article is talking about like financial stability risks associated with uh, UAPs disclosure, right?

plain: Matthew Pines, a guest who talks about UFOs and global power, says that four or five years before the show he posted a half-joking tweet asking "What's your UAP hedge hashtag Bitcoin?" He wrote it in reply to an article on FT Alphaville, a Financial Times blog, about the risks to financial stability if governments disclosed what they know about UAP, the official term for UFOs. The point behind the joke is that such a revelation could shake markets enough that people might want something like Bitcoin as insurance.
